accounting.rationale: The actual original production says object-name-list, not array-name-list. R401 supplies a nonempty comma-separated list. Explicit R804/C810 govern object-name and override the assumed R402 name convention under4.1.3p2. Neither an array/coarray specification nor a component designator is part of this production.

The original normative paragraph defines the statement-to-attribute route for the listed objects and cites8.5.7. C830 and the canonical S8.5.7 requirements retain eligibility, dummy contiguity, pointer-target and other contiguity semantics. No duplicate local S effect, executable operation or no-op classifier is introduced.

8.5.1 permits an attribute specification statement as an explicit route. R839 is not an ALLOCATE, pointer assignment, actual-argument conversion, contiguity inquiry or transfer operation. A CONTIGUOUS spelling inside a type declaration is a different grammar occurrence.

C830 permits an array pointer, an assumed-shape array or an assumed-rank dummy data object. Actual contiguity, an ordinary dummy role or scalar RANK(0) does not create eligibility. A genuinely assumed-rank dummy can have a scalar effective argument; that is not an ordinary fixed-rank scalar or scalar pointer.

Each named object receives the attribute subject to its actual declaration and scope. Type, rank and array category must be established by their proper declarations; R839 supplies no shape or pointer attribute. Each list member separately meets C830, C815 and relevant use/host/BLOCK conditions. No blanket rule requiring every attribute statement to follow its type declaration is invented.

PENDING finite source relations to8.5.7,9.5.4, pointer assignment and actual/dummy/state rules. The existing14C830 compile cases and2S8.5.7-001 runtime cases retain owners, source bytes, evidence roles, fingerprints and reviews. Their CONTIGUOUS occurrences are in type declarations, not R839 statements; existing failures, ICEs or UNTESTED plans cannot become statement evidence through this catalogue.

requirements.title: A CONTIGUOUS statement has an optional double colon and a nonempty object-name list
requirements.source: 8.6.6 R839, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF136, printed122.
requirements.definition: The CONTIGUOUS keyword is followed by an optional double colon and a nonempty comma-separated list of object names. R804/C810 supplies the explicit object-name production, rather than an assumed R402 or an array-name production. R839 specifies the existing CONTIGUOUS attribute; it supplies no type, array/coarray specification, pointer association or executable contiguity test. Every subject must independently satisfy C830 and the declaration/scope rules.

pending.multiple-distinct-eligible-objects: PENDING a complete program with separately declared INTEGER pointer arrays p(:), q(:), each named once in CONTIGUOUS :: p, q. A separate qualified mixed-category control uses an explicit-interface module procedure with nonallocatable nonpointer dummy x(:) and local array pointer p(:), then CONTIGUOUS :: x, p. Every object is independently eligible; no undefined pointer or dummy payload is inspected and list syntax is not a runtime effect.
pending.list-separator-repair: PENDING a complete source with two distinct eligible pointer-array names and one missing comma, repaired only by inserting that comma; separately, a trailing-comma contrast is repaired only by deleting the trailing comma. R401 owns the assumed list convention. Hold entity identity, pointer/rank declarations and the single explicit CONTIGUOUS specification fixed, so duplicate attributes or invalid subject categories cannot masquerade as list errors.
pending.bare-name-not-declarator-or-designator: PENDING a complete INTEGER pointer-array context containing CONTIGUOUS :: p(:), repaired by removing only the suffix while retaining p's actual deferred-shape declaration elsewhere. The syntax here has no array/coarray declarator groups. Component designators, array elements/sections and function references are not object-name; keep their exact owners. In particular, deleting %member from an ordinary derived scalar does not give an eligible C830 control, so such component-specific negatives remain gated until a complete role-valid single-predicate repair exists. Do not copy another attribute statement's permissive declarator grammar.
pending.entity-category-and-rank-source: PENDING canonical C830 and8.5.8 source relations: separately declared array pointers, true assumed-shape dummies, ordinary assumed-rank dummies and ALLOCATABLE assumed-rank dummies retain their exact categories. Ordinary scalars, scalar pointers, explicit-shape arrays, fixed-rank allocatable arrays and assumed-size dummies are not admitted merely by naming them. RANK(0) makes an ordinary entity scalar under8.5.17p2; dummy status alone is insufficient. A genuine x(..) dummy may receive a scalar effective argument, but that is not an array-name shortcut or a new IS_CONTIGUOUS effect. The existing14type-declaration C830 cases remain source prerequisites, not statement witnesses or templates to clone into duplicate eligibility credit.
pending.single-specification-and-order-source: PENDING complete local source contrasts with exactly one explicit CONTIGUOUS route. A type-declaration CONTIGUOUS plus a separate CONTIGUOUS statement, or repetition of the same entity in statements/lists, belongs to C815's attribute-uniqueness rule, not a new R839 grammar defect. Initial controls establish type/rank first for clarity; any alternate attribute/type/shape ordering must follow8.2/8.5.1 rather than an invented universal prior-type requirement. Array or RANK-clause declarations must be mutually compatible and remain under C834/C863/C864.
pending.use-host-block-source-identity: PENDING finite source/interface controls with complete provider and scope definitions.14.2.2p9 does not permit a CONTIGUOUS statement to respecify a USE-associated object's attributes. For host names, resolve19.5.1.4p1/p2 rather than assuming this statement alone introduces a fresh local array or authorizes a change of host attributes; confirmation/change variants stay source-gated until that relation is established.11.1.4p2 makes CONTIGUOUS a nonexceptional BLOCK specification, unlike ASYNCHRONOUS/IMPORT/VOLATILE. A clear BLOCK control declares its own typed pointer array before the statement; it does not re-attribute the enclosing scalar or array merely through a shared name.
pending.attribute-and-runtime-evidence-boundary: PENDING exact canonical8.5.7/9.5.4 and15.5.2 relations, not new local effect programs. A CONTIGUOUS assumed-shape/assumed-rank dummy can have a permitted noncontiguous actual, but explicit interfaces, matching type/kind/rank, INOUT definability, nonvector actuals and applicable C1548/C1549 conditions remain. A CONTIGUOUS pointer dummy has the separate C1550 simply-contiguous-actual rule, and pointer assignment retains10.2.2.3p6. IS_CONTIGUOUS requires an assumed-rank object or array and an associated pointer if POINTER; rank-zero truth alone is not attribute evidence. Preserve the two complete S8.5.7-001 runtime parents, their actual inquiries/guarded payloads, real failures and parent-qualified or UNTESTED sensitivity plans. They use type-declaration attributes, so neither their runs nor the14C830 compile controls are relabelled R839 statement tests. No copy-in/out, address, descriptor, stride or allocation strategy is promised.

requirements.oracle:
Complete compile/positive-controls for actual standalone statement forms, plus source-minimal missing-list, list-separator and whole-name grammar contrasts with valid C830 subjects. Full cases must isolate the intended syntax relation and retain required source/interface prerequisites. The explicit name production and canonical attribute/shape/state owners remain separate; all source/use relationships require independent adjudication before credit.

R839 finite missing-list matrix: four complete module compile/f2023 fixtures use one separately declared ordinary INTEGER,POINTER subject(:). Each negative has a standalone CONTIGUOUS or CONTIGUOUS :: statement with no object-name list. Its sole repair inserts ' subject' at the end of that same physical statement, retaining the chosen separator form and every other byte. The two distinct compile positive controls name that actual rank-one deferred-shape array pointer, independently satisfying C830/C834, through the sole explicit CONTIGUOUS route. R401 requires a nonempty list; explicit R804/C810, not an assumed R402 production, owns the data-object name. Reporting is qualified by the forbidden form in this complete source/control context, not by a required diagnostic vocabulary. At the actual staged listless statement on line4, the exact 'expected object names' and 'Invalid character in name at (1)' messages identify the absent first name. The latter is the expected-name parser's end-of-statement failure here, not a separate illegal character elsewhere. Only the double-colon negative also admits the exact 'Newline is unexpected here' cause: its terminator immediately follows the valid CONTIGUOUS :: prefix where that first name is mandatory. Full-message and live-origin predicates remain case-specific. No lookahead/EOF point, widened interval or additional span is used. Each one-insertion control must produce its object; no link or runtime operation is requested.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Numbered syntax reporting capability does not mandate fatal rejection, a printed R839 or specific English. Bare array/CONTIGUOUS words, wrong entity categories, incompatible shape, missing modules/interfaces, unrelated state/definability failures, unsupported facilities, source echoes, quoted examples, Internal/ASR/verifier errors, crashes and resource failures cannot qualify. Optional colons do not make the list optional or admit inline rank/shape syntax. Declaration admission is not association, allocation, defined payload, simply-contiguous actual availability or runtime IS_CONTIGUOUS evidence. Unallocated/disassociated/undefined objects are not read or queried without the intrinsic's exact premises, and no runtime requirement is downgraded to compile-only. Existing source, case, role, link, SourceUses, baseline and observation records are neither changed nor renewed.

R839 finite missing-list boundaries: only double-colon-form, no-double-colon-form and missing-object-list are represented. Both missing-list alternatives have their own complete negative and distinct repair; controls carry their form facet and missing-object-list as compile positive controls. The other facet plans and raw source/fixture/evidence states remain independently managed. The source has no malformed declaration, invalid subject category or missing END MODULE; the first missing object name is the sole defect. These condition-bound causes do not license arbitrary name/newline tokens or an error elsewhere. In particular, the bare-form 'Attribute declaration not supported yet' report remains unqualified, and the newline alternative is not enabled for that form. Unlisted messages, fragments, quoted/echoed causes, context-only or malformed locations, foreign origins, EOF/missing-END reports, unsupported features and native/internal/resource failures do not qualify. Reporting capability does not mandate fatal status, fixed English or printed R839, and no unobserved warning allowance is introduced. Effective source/case reviews and current fingerprint-, phase- and mode-bound observations determine qualification; f2018 evidence cannot substitute for f2023 corroboration. Historical verdicts belong to their immutable dated reports, not regenerated present-state assertions. There is no pointer initialization, association inquiry, payload access, allocation, call, runtime contiguity, layout, descriptor or strategy oracle. Existing C830 and S8.5.7-001 witnesses retain their type-declaration occurrences, owners, roles, fingerprints, reviews and historical failures/ICEs or UNTESTED plans. Generation alone grants no approval, baseline update or new C830/runtime/link/SourceUses credit.
